## About this item

* * *

* * *

Here at INABA, we know your cat is a beloved family member. That's why each of INABA Churu Cat Treats is made from high-quality ingredients, including wild-caught tuna & farm-raised chicken. We have made these a high-moisture, low-calorie cat treat that your kitties will love. They contain 91% moisture and have only six calories per tube. That's a 1/10th of the calories of traditional dry cat treats and more than 1000x the moisture (8% vs. 91%). We've added Vitamin E for immunity. They’re grain-free, preservative-free, carrageenan-free & free from artificial colors, making them a cat treat you can feel good about feeding. Designed to be hand-fed, you can use it to help calm the feistiest of outdoor ferals or treat your pampered indoor pussycat. Use as a dry/wet cat food topper or to assist with medications. Inaba makes snack time fun for you and your feline friends.

With 40 distinct tubes, the Churu Tuna Variety Pack offers an array of flavors, catering to picky cats and enhancing mealtime enjoyment.

High-Quality Ingredients

Made from premium tuna, this pack ensures rich taste and nutritional benefits, promoting healthy eating and satisfaction for your feline friend.

Interactive Treats

Designed as a fun and engaging treat, these tubes encourage bonding and playtime, making them perfect for training or rewarding your pet.
